SELECT DISTINCT
  p.repository_name_with_owner AS repository_name_with_owner,
  p.repository_host_type AS hosting_platform,
  CAST(p.repository_size * 1024 AS INT64) AS repository_size_bytes,
  p.repository_language AS primary_language,
  p.repository_fork_source_name_with_owner AS fork_source_name,
  p.repository_updated_timestamp AS last_update_timestamp,
  ft.artifact_name,
  ft.library_name,
  ft.languages
FROM `bigquery-public-data.libraries_io.dependencies` d
JOIN feature_toggle_libs ft
  ON d.dependency_name = ft.artifact_name
  AND d.dependency_platform = ft.platform
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.libraries_io.projects_with_repository_fields` p
  ON d.project_id = p.id
ORDER BY p.repository_name_with_owner, ft.artifact_name
